local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VoiceChatService = game:GetService("VoiceChatService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- System Configuration
local MAX_HOTBAR = 5 
local clickThreshold = 15 
local SLOT_SIZE = 48 
local SLOT_PADDING = 10 
local INV_SLOT_SIZE = 50 

-- Tool Tracking State
local hotbarList = {}
local inventoryList = {}
local currentSearchText = ""

-- Feature States
local canMoveIcons = false
local canMoveHotbar = false

-- 1. Disable the default Roblox backpack UI
pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false) end)

-- 2. Create the ScreenGui Container
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "DeltaInventorySystem"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true 
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Forward declaration for UI update & Revert function
local renderUI
local function revertToDefault()
    pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, true) end)
    if screenGui then
        screenGui:Destroy()
    end
end

-- 3. Topbar Container & Icons
local baseOffsetX = 105 
local isVoiceEnabled = false
pcall(function() isVoiceEnabled = VoiceChatService:IsVoiceEnabledForUserIdAsync(player.UserId) end)
if isVoiceEnabled then baseOffsetX = baseOffsetX + 45 end

local topbarContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
topbarContainer.Name = "TopbarContainer"
topbarContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 85, 0, 36)
topbarContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, baseOffsetX, 0, 4)
topbarContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
topbarContainer.Parent = screenGui

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Name = "InventoryToggle"
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
toggleBtn.Text = "🎒"
toggleBtn.TextScaled = true
toggleBtn.Parent = topbarContainer
Instance.new("UICorner", toggleBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local settingsBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
settingsBtn.Name = "SettingsToggle"
settingsBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36)
settingsBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 0)
settingsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
settingsBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
settingsBtn.Text = "⚙️"
settingsBtn.TextScaled = true
settingsBtn.Parent = topbarContainer
Instance.new("UICorner", settingsBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local function addStroke(gui)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    stroke.Thickness = 1.2
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    stroke.Parent = gui
end
addStroke(toggleBtn)
addStroke(settingsBtn)

-- 4. Dragging Helper Logic
local function makeDraggable(frame, triggerObjects, conditionFunc)
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    for _, obj in ipairs(triggerObjects) do
        obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if conditionFunc() and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = frame.Position
            end
        end)
    end
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end

-- 5. Settings Panel
local settingsPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
settingsPanel.Name = "SettingsPanel"
settingsPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 270)
settingsPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 0.4, -135)
settingsPanel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
settingsPanel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
settingsPanel.Visible = false
settingsPanel.Parent = screenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", settingsPanel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
addStroke(settingsPanel)

local setLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
setLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
setLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
setLayout.Parent = settingsPanel

local setPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
setPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 15)
setPadding.Parent = settingsPanel

local setLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
setLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
setLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
setLabel.Text = "Inventory Settings"
setLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
setLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
setLabel.TextSize = 18
setLabel.Parent = settingsPanel

local function createToggle(name, text, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 30)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.Parent = settingsPanel
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = frame
    
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.8, 0)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.1, 0)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
    btn.Text = "OFF"
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    btn.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    
    local state = false
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
        btn.Text = state and "ON" or "OFF"
        callback(state)
    end)
end

local function createCounter(labelName, getVal, setVal, minVal, maxVal)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 30)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.Parent = settingsPanel
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = labelName
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = frame
    
    local minusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    minusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.12, 0, 0.8, 0)
    minusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0.1, 0)
    minusBtn.Text = "-"
    minusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    minusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    minusBtn.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", minusBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    
    local valLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.18, 0, 0.8, 0)
    valLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.68, 0, 0.1, 0)
    valLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valLabel.Text = tostring(getVal())
    valLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    valLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    valLabel.TextSize = 14
    valLabel.Parent = frame

    local plusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    plusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.12, 0, 0.8, 0)
    plusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.87, 0, 0.1, 0)
    plusBtn.Text = "+"
    plusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    plusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    plusBtn.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", plusBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    minusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local current = getVal()
        if current > minVal then
            setVal(current - 1)
            valLabel.Text = tostring(getVal())
            if renderUI then renderUI() end
        end
    end)

    plusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local current = getVal()
        if current < maxVal then
            setVal(current + 1)
            valLabel.Text = tostring(getVal())
            if renderUI then renderUI() end
        end
    end)
end

createCounter("Hotbar Size", function() return SLOT_SIZE end, function(v) SLOT_SIZE = v end, 25, 80)
createCounter("Hotbar Slots", function() return MAX_HOTBAR end, function(v) 
    MAX_HOTBAR = v 
    while #hotbarList > MAX_HOTBAR do
        table.insert(inventoryList, table.remove(hotbarList))
    end
end, 1, 10)

createToggle("IconMover", "Move Icons", function(state) canMoveIcons = state end)
createToggle("HotbarMover", "Move Hotbar", function(state) canMoveHotbar = state end)

-- Revert Button Inside Settings
local revertContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
revertContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 35)
revertContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
revertContainer.Parent = settingsPanel

local revertBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
revertBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
revertBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
revertBtn.Text = "REVERT TO DEFAULT"
revertBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
revertBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
revertBtn.TextSize = 14
revertBtn.Parent = revertContainer
Instance.new("UICorner", revertBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
addStroke(revertBtn)

revertBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(revertToDefault)

makeDraggable(topbarContainer, {toggleBtn, settingsBtn}, function() return canMoveIcons end)

-- 6. Inventory Container & Search Bar
local invContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
invContainer.Name = "InventoryContainer"
invContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0.5, 0)
invContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.25, 0)
invContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
invContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
invContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0
invContainer.Visible = false
invContainer.Parent = screenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", invContainer).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
addStroke(invContainer)

-- Drop Box with Warning Label
local dropBox = Instance.new("Frame")
dropBox.Name = "DropBox"
dropBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 95, 0, 120)
dropBox.Position = UDim2.new(1, 10, 0, 0)
dropBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
dropBox.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
dropBox.Visible = false
dropBox.Parent = invContainer
Instance.new("UICorner", dropBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
addStroke(dropBox)

local dropBoxText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
dropBoxText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
dropBoxText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10)
dropBoxText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
dropBoxText.Text = "DROP"
dropBoxText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
dropBoxText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
dropBoxText.TextSize = 18
dropBoxText.TextScaled = true
dropBoxText.Parent = dropBox

local dropWarning = Instance.new("TextLabel")
dropWarning.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 60)
dropWarning.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 55)
dropWarning.BackgroundTransparency = 1
dropWarning.Text = "This doesnt work in some games"
dropWarning.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
dropWarning.Font = Enum.Font.Code
dropWarning.TextSize = 11
dropWarning.TextWrapped = true
dropWarning.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
dropWarning.Parent = dropBox

-- Toggle DropBox visibility along with inventory
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
    invContainer.Visible = not invContainer.Visible 
    dropBox.Visible = invContainer.Visible
end)
settingsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() settingsPanel.Visible = not settingsPanel.Visible end)

local searchIcon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
searchIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 35)
searchIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 10)
searchIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
searchIcon.Text = "🔎"
searchIcon.TextScaled = true
searchIcon.Parent = invContainer

local searchInput = Instance.new("TextBox")
searchInput.Size = UDim2.new(1, -65, 0, 35)
searchInput.Position = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 10)
searchInput.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
searchInput.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
searchInput.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
searchInput.Text = "" 
searchInput.PlaceholderText = "Search"
searchInput.Font = Enum.Font.Code
searchInput.TextSize = 16
searchInput.ClearTextOnFocus = false
searchInput.Parent = invContainer
Instance.new("UICorner", searchInput).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
addStroke(searchInput)

local invScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
invScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -55)
invScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 55)
invScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
invScroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
invScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 6
invScroll.Parent = invContainer

local gridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
gridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, INV_SLOT_SIZE, 0, INV_SLOT_SIZE) 
gridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
gridLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
gridLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
gridLayout.Parent = invScroll

local gridPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
gridPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5)
gridPadding.Parent = invScroll

-- 7. Unified Hotbar Frame
local hotbarFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
hotbarFrame.Name = "HotbarFrame"
hotbarFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0) 
hotbarFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.85, 0) 
hotbarFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
hotbarFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
hotbarFrame.Parent = screenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", hotbarFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
addStroke(hotbarFrame)

local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
listLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
listLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
listLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, SLOT_PADDING) 
listLayout.Parent = hotbarFrame

makeDraggable(hotbarFrame, {hotbarFrame}, function() return canMoveHotbar end)

-- 8. Core Mechanics
local function isInside(pos, guiObject)
    if not guiObject.Visible then return false end
    local tl = guiObject.AbsolutePosition
    local br = tl + guiObject.AbsoluteSize
    return pos.X >= tl.X and pos.X <= br.X and pos.Y >= tl.Y and pos.Y <= br.Y
end

local function triggerDrop(tool)
    if not tool then return end
    tool.CanBeDropped = true
    tool.Parent = workspace
    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
        local character = player.Character
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            task.wait()
            handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 15) + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
        end
    end
end

local function syncTools()
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
    
    local currentTools = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do if item:IsA("Tool") then currentTools[item] = true end end
    for _, item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do if item:IsA("Tool") then currentTools[item] = true end end
    
    for i = #hotbarList, 1, -1 do if not currentTools[hotbarList[i]] then table.remove(hotbarList, i) end end
    for i = #inventoryList, 1, -1 do if not currentTools[inventoryList[i]] then table.remove(inventoryList, i) end end
    
    for tool in pairs(currentTools) do
        if not table.find(hotbarList, tool) and not table.find(inventoryList, tool) then
            if #hotbarList < MAX_HOTBAR then
                table.insert(hotbarList, tool)
            else
                table.insert(inventoryList, tool)
            end
        end
    end
end

renderUI = function()
    for _, child in ipairs(invScroll:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end end
    for _, child in ipairs(hotbarFrame:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end end

    local hotbarWidth = (MAX_HOTBAR * SLOT_SIZE) + ((MAX_HOTBAR - 1) * SLOT_PADDING) + 12
    hotbarFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, hotbarWidth, 0, SLOT_SIZE + 10)

    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    local function createSlot(tool, parentFrame)
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Name = tool.Name
        btn.Text = tool.Name
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
        btn.TextScaled = true
        btn.Parent = parentFrame
        
        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        corner.Parent = btn
        
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke.Parent = btn

        if parentFrame == hotbarFrame then
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, SLOT_SIZE, 0, SLOT_SIZE)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
            stroke.Thickness = 1
            if tool.Parent == character then
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
            else
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
            end
        else
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, INV_SLOT_SIZE, 0, INV_SLOT_SIZE)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
            stroke.Thickness = 1.2
            if tool.Parent == character then
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
            else
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
            end
        end

        local dragging = false
        local dragInput, dragStart, ghostBtn
        local lastClickTick = 0

        btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                dragging = true
                dragInput = input
                dragStart = input.Position
            end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and input == dragInput then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                if delta.Magnitude >= clickThreshold then
                    if not ghostBtn then
                        ghostBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                        ghostBtn.Size = btn.Size
                        ghostBtn.Text = tool.Name
                        ghostBtn.TextScaled = true
                        ghostBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
                        ghostBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
                        ghostBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
                        ghostBtn.ZIndex = 10
                        ghostBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                        Instance.new("UICorner", ghostBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
                        ghostBtn.Parent = screenGui
                        
                        btn.TextTransparency = 0.8
                        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
                    end
                    ghostBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, input.Position.X, 0, input.Position.Y)
                end
            end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and input == dragInput then
                dragging = false
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart

                if ghostBtn then
                    local dropPos = input.Position
                    ghostBtn:Destroy()
                    ghostBtn = nil

                    if isInside(dropPos, dropBox) then
                        local invIdx = table.find(inventoryList, tool)
                        if invIdx then table.remove(inventoryList, invIdx) end
                        local hotIdx = table.find(hotbarList, tool)
                        if hotIdx then table.remove(hotbarList, hotIdx) end
                        triggerDrop(tool)
                    elseif isInside(dropPos, hotbarFrame) then
                        if not table.find(hotbarList, tool) then
                            local invIdx = table.find(inventoryList, tool)
                            if invIdx then table.remove(inventoryList, invIdx) end
                            
                            if #hotbarList >= MAX_HOTBAR then
                                table.insert(inventoryList, table.remove(hotbarList, 1))
                            end
                            table.insert(hotbarList, tool)
                        end
                    elseif isInside(dropPos, invContainer) then
                        if not table.find(inventoryList, tool) then
                            local hotIdx = table.find(hotbarList, tool)
                            if hotIdx then table.remove(hotbarList, hotIdx) end
                            table.insert(inventoryList, tool)
                        end
                    end
                    renderUI() 
                else
                    if delta.Magnitude < clickThreshold then
                        if parentFrame == invScroll then
                            local currentTick = tick()
                            if currentTick - lastClickTick < 0.35 then
                                if #hotbarList < MAX_HOTBAR then
                                    local invIdx = table.find(inventoryList, tool)
                                    if invIdx then
                                        table.remove(inventoryList, invIdx)
                                        table.insert(hotbarList, tool)
                                        renderUI()
                                    end
                                end
                                lastClickTick = 0
                            else
                                lastClickTick = currentTick
                            end
                        else
                            if tool.Parent == character then humanoid:UnequipTools()
                            else humanoid:EquipTool(tool) end
                            renderUI()
                        end
                    end
                end
                dragInput = nil
            end
        end)
    end

    for _, tool in ipairs(hotbarList) do createSlot(tool, hotbarFrame) end
    for _, tool in ipairs(inventoryList) do 
        if currentSearchText == "" or string.find(string.lower(tool.Name), currentSearchText, 1, true) then
            createSlot(tool, invScroll) 
        end
    end
end
_G.updateUI = renderUI 

-- 9. Main Loop & Listeners
local function update()
    syncTools()
    renderUI()
end

searchInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    currentSearchText = string.lower(searchInput.Text)
    renderUI()
end)

local function setupListeners()
    local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
    backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(update)
    backpack.ChildRemoved:Connect(update)
    
    if player.Character then
        player.Character.ChildAdded:Connect(update)
        player.Character.ChildRemoved:Connect(update)
    end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    setupListeners()
    update()
end)

setupListeners()
update()

scripts.script:
if _G.AntiBang_Shutdown then
    pcall(_G.AntiBang_Shutdown)
    _G.AntiBang_Shutdown = nil
end

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterGui       = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- {{ toggle }}

local CONFIG = {
    ENABLED = true, -- turn anti off or on (use true or false)
}

local NOTIFY = true -- notify if it succeeded (use true or false)

local function getTorso(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getRoot(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return (hum and hum.RootPart) or char.PrimaryPart
end

local function notify(title, text)
    if not NOTIFY then return end
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = title, Text = text, Duration = 3
        })
    end)
end

local function matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso)
    local theirChar = plr.Character
    if not theirChar then return false end

    local theirHRP = theirChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not theirHRP then return false end

    local localOffset = myTorso.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(theirHRP.Position)

    if math.abs(localOffset.X) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Y) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Z - 1.1) > 0.25 then return false end

    local dot = theirHRP.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(myTorso.CFrame.LookVector)
    if dot < 0.995 then return false end

    return true
end

local dipBusy = false
local function voidDip()
    if dipBusy then return end
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local root = getRoot(myChar)
    if not root or not root.Parent then return end

    dipBusy = true
    local savedCF = root.CFrame
    local savedDH = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -1e9

    local t0 = tick()
    pcall(function()
        while tick() - t0 < 0.15 do
            if not root.Parent then break end
            root.CFrame                  = CFrame.new(0, -800, 0)
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            task.wait()
        end
    end)

    if root.Parent then
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.CFrame                  = savedCF
        local hum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end
    end

    task.wait()
    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = savedDH
    dipBusy = false
end

local confirmCount = {}
local lastAction   = 0

local steppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not CONFIG.ENABLED then return end
    if dipBusy then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local myTorso = getTorso(myChar)
    if not myTorso then return end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            if matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso) then
                confirmCount[plr] = (confirmCount[plr] or 0) + 1

                if confirmCount[plr] >= 5 then
                    confirmCount[plr] = 0

                    if tick() - lastAction < 1.5 then
                        return
                    end
                    lastAction = tick()

                    notify("Anti-Bang", "Bang confirmed from " .. plr.Name)
                    voidDip()
                    return
                end
            else
                confirmCount[plr] = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)

local inputConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
        CONFIG.ENABLED = not CONFIG.ENABLED
        notify("Anti-Bang", CONFIG.ENABLED and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
    end
end)

local removeConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    confirmCount[plr] = nil
end)

local charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    confirmCount = {}
    dipBusy      = false
end)

_G.AntiBang_Shutdown = function()
    steppedConn:Disconnect()
    inputConn:Disconnect()
    removeConn:Disconnect()
    charConn:Disconnect()
end

_G.AntiBang_Toggle = function(state)
    if type(state) == "boolean" then
        CONFIG.ENABLED = state
    else
        CONFIG.ENABLED = not CONFIG.ENABLED
    end
    notify("Anti-Bang", CONFIG.ENABLED and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
end

notify("Anti-Bang", "Loaded")

local white = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local inkCol = rgb(30, 30, 36)
local bgCol, lineCol, accent, offCol = rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(210, 210, 218), rgb(149, 92, 215), rgb(205, 205, 212)
local cartoon = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local fast = TweenInfo.new(0.15)
local popTi = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local sizes = {main = 138, settings = 178}
local pieceKeys = {"hl", "bb", "boxGui", "line"}

local espColor = rgb(255, 0, 0)
local teamColor = rgb(60, 100, 255)
local isOn, hlOn, unOn, tnOn, boxOn, tracerOn, teamOn = false, true, true, false, false, false, false
local isOpen, curTab = true, "main"
local espData, woahjConns, pickers = {}, {}, {}
local addConn, remConn, lineConn, lpTeamConn
local onMove, held
local woahj
local presetColors = {rgb(255, 0, 0), rgb(255, 140, 0), rgb(255, 230, 0), rgb(0, 255, 120), rgb(0, 220, 255), rgb(60, 100, 255), rgb(149, 92, 215), rgb(30, 30, 36)}

local moveConn = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(m)
	if onMove and (m.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or m.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		onMove(m)
	end
end)
local endConn = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
	if held and (i == held or (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and held.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)) then
		onMove, held = nil, nil
	end
end)

local function isPress(i)
	return i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end
local function startDrag(i, fn)
	held = i
	onMove = function(m)
		if m == i or m.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			fn(m)
		end
	end
end
local function make(class, props, par)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, val in props do
		o[k] = val
	end
	o.Parent = par
	return o
end
local function corner(o, a, b)
	make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(a, b or 0)}, o)
end
local function stroke(o, c, t, tr)
	return make("UIStroke", {Color = c, Thickness = t or 1, Transparency = tr or 0}, o)
end
local function makeToggle(par, pos)
	local b = make("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Size = offset(44, 22), Position = pos, BackgroundColor3 = offCol, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0}, par)
	local k = make("Frame", {Size = offset(16, 16), Position = udim(0, 3, 0.5, -8), BackgroundColor3 = white, BorderSizePixel = 0}, b)
	corner(b, 1)
	corner(k, 1)
	return b, k
end
local function skin(b, k, state, instant)
	local col = state and accent or offCol
	local pos = state and udim(1, -19, 0.5, -8) or udim(0, 3, 0.5, -8)
	if instant then
		b.BackgroundColor3 = col
		k.Position = pos
	else
		TS:Create(b, fast, {BackgroundColor3 = col}):Play()
		TS:Create(k, fast, {Position = pos}):Play()
	end
end
local function rowLabel(par, txt, pos)
	return make("TextLabel", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Size = offset(80, 22), Position = pos, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = txt, Font = cartoon, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = rgb(50, 50, 58), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, par)

local function makeKnob(par, z, col)
	local k = make("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = offset(16, 16), BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z}, par)
	corner(k, 1)
	stroke(k, inkCol, 2.5)

	end
	return espColor
end
local function teamText(player)

local tnBtn, tnKnob = makeToggle(setBody, udim(1, -58, 0, 100))
local boxBtn, boxKnob = makeToggle(setBody, udim(1, -58, 0, 140))

local welcome = make("Frame", {Name = "WelcomePopup", Size = offset(360, 180), Position = udim(0.5, -180, 0.5, -90), BackgroundColor3 = rgb(22, 22, 26), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 100}, gui)
local welcomeTitle = make("TextLabel", {Size = udim(1, -30, 0, 28), Position = offset(15, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "hello hi this is made by", TextColor3 = white, Font = Enum.Font.Cartoon, TextSize = 20, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 101}, welcome)
local welcomeLink = make("TextLabel", {Size = udim(1, -20, 0, 40), Position = offset(10, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "https://scriptblox.com/u/indistiputed", TextColor3 = white, Font = Enum.Font.Cartoon, TextSize = 15, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 101}, welcome)

local function circleBtn(txt, x, size)
	local b = make("TextButton", {Size = offset(24, 24), Position = udim(1, x, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = rgb(238, 238, 243), Text = txt, Font = cartoon, TextSize = size, TextColor3 = rgb(60, 60, 70), BorderSizePixel = 0}, frame)

end

local minimizeBtn, closeBtn = circleBtn("-", -56, 16), circleBtn("x", -28, 14)

make("TextLabel", {Size = udim(1, -12, 1, 0), Position = offset(12, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "simple lil esp", Font = cartoon, TextSize = 16, TextColor3 = inkCol, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, head)
rowLabel(mainBody, "Player ESP", udim(0, 14, 0, 20))
rowLabel(mainBody, "Team based", udim(0, 14, 0, 60))
rowLabel(setBody, "Highlight", udim(0, 14, 0, 20))
rowLabel(setBody, "Usernames", udim(0, 14, 0, 60))
rowLabel(setBody, "Team name", udim(0, 14, 0, 100))

rowLabel(setBody, "Tracers", udim(0, 14, 0, 180))
corner(frame, 0, 10)
stroke(frame, lineCol)
corner(tabMain, 0, 8)
corner(tabSet, 0, 8)
corner(welcome, 0, 12)
stroke(welcome, rgb(48, 48, 55), 1)
corner(okBtn, 0, 8)
skin(hlBtn, hlKnob, hlOn, true)
skin(unBtn, unKnob, unOn, true)

local ok = pcall(function()
	local par = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
	gui.Parent = par
	tracerGui.Parent = par
end)
if not ok then
	gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	tracerGui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local function makePicker(par, pos, startColor, onChange)
	local api = {}
	local h, s, v = startColor:ToHSV()
	local color = startColor
	local open, queued = false, false
	local swatch = make("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Size = offset(26, 26), Position = pos, BackgroundColor3 = color, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0}, par)
	local pop = make("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Size = offset(190, 196), Position = udim(0.5, 0, 1, 6), BackgroundColor3 = bgCol, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false}, frame)
	local popBase = stroke(pop, rgb(225, 225, 232), 2)
	local popStroke = stroke(pop, white, 2)
	local popGrad = make("UIGradient", {Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, 0.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.48, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, 0.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.98, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})}, popStroke)
	local popScale = make("UIScale", {}, pop)
	local svBox = make("Frame", {Size = offset(170, 96), Position = offset(10, 10), BackgroundColor3 = white, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true}, pop)
	local svGrad = make("UIGradient", {}, svBox)
	local darkOverlay = make("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2}, svBox)
	local hueSlider = make("Frame", {Size = offset(170, 20), Position = offset(10, 112), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = true}, pop)
	local hueBar = make("Frame", {Size = udim(1, 0, 0, 10), Position = udim(0, 0, 0.5, -5), BackgroundColor3 = white, BorderSizePixel = 0}, hueSlider)
	local previewDot = make("Frame", {Size = offset(24, 24), Position = offset(10, 162), BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0}, pop)
	local rgbInput = make("TextBox", {Size = offset(130, 24), Position = offset(50, 162), BackgroundColor3 = rgb(238, 238, 243), BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = cartoon, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = inkCol, PlaceholderText = "255, 0, 0", PlaceholderColor3 = rgb(150, 150, 160), ClearTextOnFocus = false, Text = "255, 0, 0"}, pop)
	local svKnob, hueKnob = makeKnob(svBox, 3, color), makeKnob(hueSlider, 2, color)
	local inputStroke = stroke(rgbInput, lineCol, 1.5)
	local spinTween = TS:Create(popGrad, TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.In, -1), {Rotation = 360})

	make("UIGradient", {Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0), Rotation = 90}, darkOverlay)
	make("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, rgb(255, 0, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1 / 6, rgb(255, 255, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(2 / 6, rgb(0, 255, 0)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(3 / 6, rgb(0, 255, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(4 / 6, rgb(0, 0, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(5 / 6, rgb(255, 0, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, rgb(255, 0, 0)),
	})}, hueBar)
	corner(swatch, 0, 8)
	stroke(swatch, inkCol, 1.5, 0.6)
	corner(pop, 0, 12)
	corner(svBox, 0, 8)
	corner(darkOverlay, 0, 8)
	corner(hueBar, 1)
	corner(previewDot, 1)
	stroke(previewDot, inkCol, 1, 0.6)
	corner(rgbInput, 0, 8)

	local function paint()
		color = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
		swatch.BackgroundColor3 = color
		previewDot.BackgroundColor3 = color
		svKnob.BackgroundColor3 = color
		hueKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1)
		svGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(white, Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1))
		popGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, accent), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.48, color), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, accent),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.98, color), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, accent),
		})
		svKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(s, 1 - v)
		hueKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(h, 0.5)
		rgbInput.Text = string.format("%d, %d, %d", math.round(color.R * 255), math.round(color.G * 255), math.round(color.B * 255))
	end

	local function changed()
		if queued then
			return
		end
		queued = true
		task.defer(function()
			queued = false
			paint()
			onChange(color)
		end)
	end

	for i, c in presetColors do
		local chip = make("TextButton", {Size = offset(16, 16), Position = offset(10 + (i - 1) * 22, 138), BackgroundColor3 = c, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0}, pop)
		corner(chip, 1)
		stroke(chip, inkCol, 1, 0.6)
		chip.Activated:Connect(function()
			h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
			changed()
		end)
	end

	local function idk(i, name)
		if name == "sv" then
			s = math.clamp((i.Position.X - svBox.AbsolutePosition.X) / svBox.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
			v = 1 - math.clamp((i.Position.Y - svBox.AbsolutePosition.Y) / svBox.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0, 1)
		else
			h = math.clamp((i.Position.X - hueSlider.AbsolutePosition.X) / hueSlider.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 0.999)
		end
		changed()
	end

	local function bindSlider(fr, name)
		fr.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			if not isPress(i) then
				return
			end
			idk(i, name)
			startDrag(i, function(m)
				idk(m, name)
			end)
		end)
	end
	bindSlider(svBox, "sv")
	bindSlider(hueSlider, "hue")

	rgbInput.Focused:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(inputStroke, fast, {Color = accent}):Play()
	end)

	rgbInput.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(inputStroke, fast, {Color = lineCol}):Play()
		local r, g, b = rgbInput.Text:match("(%d+)%D+(%d+)%D+(%d+)")
		if r then
			h, s, v = rgb(math.clamp(tonumber(r), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(g), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(b), 0, 255)):ToHSV()
		end
		changed()
	end)

	local function WHAT(state)
		open = state
		if state then
			for _, p in pickers do
				if p ~= api then
					p.close()
				end
			end
			pop.Visible = true
			popScale.Scale = 0.9
			pop.Position = udim(0.5, 0, 1, -4)
			popStroke.Transparency = 1
			popBase.Transparency = 1
			popGrad.Rotation = 0
			TS:Create(popScale, popTi, {Scale = 1}):Play()
			TS:Create(pop, popTi, {Position = udim(0.5, 0, 1, 6)}):Play()
			TS:Create(popStroke, popTi, {Transparency = 0}):Play()
			TS:Create(popBase, popTi, {Transparency = 0}):Play()
			spinTween:Play()
		else
			pop.Visible = false
			spinTween:Cancel()
		end
	end

	swatch.Activated:Connect(function()
		WHAT(not open)
	end)

	api.close = function()
		WHAT(false)
	end
	table.insert(pickers, api)
	paint()
	return api
end

local mainPicker = makePicker(mainBody, udim(0, 148, 0, 20), espColor, function(c)
	espColor = c
	woahj()
end)
local teamPicker = makePicker(mainBody, udim(0, 148, 0, 60), teamColor, function(c)
	teamColor = c
	woahj()
end)

local function closePickers()
	for _, p in pickers do
		p.close()
	end
end

woahj = function()
	for player, d in espData do
		local c = colorFor(player)
		if d.hl then
			d.hl.FillColor = c
			d.hl.OutlineColor = c
		end
		if d.tag then
			d.tag.TextColor3 = c
		end
		if d.teamTag then
			d.teamTag.TextColor3 = c
		end
		if d.boxStroke then
			d.boxStroke.Color = c
		end
		if d.line then
			d.line.BackgroundColor3 = c
		end
	end
end

lpTeamConn = LP:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function()
	woahj()
end)

local function paintTab(b, active)
	TS:Create(b, fast, {BackgroundColor3 = active and accent or rgb(238, 238, 243), TextColor3 = active and white or rgb(90, 90, 100)}):Play()
end

local function showTab(name)
	curTab = name
	mainBody.Visible = name == "main"
	setBody.Visible = name == "settings"
	closePickers()
	paintTab(tabMain, name == "main")
	paintTab(tabSet, name == "settings")
	if isOpen then
		TS:Create(frame, fast, {Size = offset(190, sizes[name])}):Play()
	end
end

local function clearEsp(player)
	local d = espData[player]
	if d then
		for _, k in pieceKeys do
			if d[k] then
				d[k]:Destroy()
			end
		end
		espData[player] = nil
	end
end

local function sync(player)
	local d = espData[player]
	if not d then
		return
	end
	local c = colorFor(player)
	if isOn and hlOn then

local function updateLines()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local vs = cam.ViewportSize
	local ax, ay = vs.X / 2, vs.Y
	for _, d in espData do
		local line = d.line
		if line then
			local rt = d.root
			local show = false
			if rt and rt.Parent then
				local p = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rt.Position)
				if p.Z > 0 then
					show = true
					if d.px ~= p.X or d.py ~= p.Y then
						d.px, d.py = p.X, p.Y
						local dx, dy = p.X - ax, p.Y - ay
						line.Position = offset(ax + dx / 2, ay + dy / 2)
						line.Size = offset(2, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy))
						line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)) - 90
					end
				else
					d.px = nil
				end
			end
			if line.Visible ~= show then
				line.Visible = show
			end
		end
	end

local function b64decode(s)
	local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
	s = s:gsub('[^' .. b .. '=]', '')
	return (s:gsub('.', function(x)

		local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
		for i = 6, 1, -1 do r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i-1) > 0 and '1' or '0') end
		return r
	end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
		if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
		local c = 0
		for i = 1, 8 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8-i) or 0) end

		end

		while completed < total do

		end

		local elapsed = tick() - t0
		print(string.format("[Unanchor All] Карта откреплена за %.2f сек! (%d частей)", elapsed, total))

	if remote then
		pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(";fogcolor black ;time") end)
	end

	local function resize(part, size, cf)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncResize", {{Part = part, CFrame = cf, Size = size}})
		end)
	end
	local function syncmaterial(part, mate)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMaterial", {{Part = part, Material = mate}})
		end)
	end
	local function transparency(part, trans)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMaterial", {{Part = part, Transparency = trans}})
		end)
	end
	local function color(part, c)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncColor", {{Part = part, Color = c, UnionColoring = false}})
		end)
	end
	local function syncmeshid(part, id)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{Part = part, MeshId = "rbxassetid://" .. id}})
		end)
	end
	local function makemesh(part)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreateMeshes", {{Part = part}})
		end)
	end
	local function syncmeshsize(part, vec)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{Part = part, Scale = vec}})

	local function syncmeshtexture(part, id)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{Part = part, TextureId = "rbxassetid://" .. id}})
		end)
	end
	local function name(part, s)

	end
	local function lock(part, b)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SetLocked", {part}, b)
		end)
	end
	local function setcollision(part, b)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncCollision", {{Part = part, CanCollide = b}})
		end)
	end
	local function createdecal(part, side)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreateTextures", {{Part = part, Face = side, TextureType = "Decal"}})
		end)
	end
	local function setdecal(part, asset, side)

			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncTexture", {{Part = part, Face = side, TextureType = "Decal", Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. asset}})
		end)
	end

	local function makerealmbase()
		local position = CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
		local base = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", position, workspace)
		resize(base, Vector3.new(512, 16, 512), position)
		syncmaterial(base, Enum.Material.Concrete)
		color(base, Color3.new(0.513725, 0.513725, 0.513725))
		name(base, "loltroll")
		lock(base, true)

		local spawnpos = CFrame.new(34.5, 8.1, -26)
		local spawna = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Spawn", spawnpos, workspace)
		resize(spawna, Vector3.new(20, 10, 20), spawnpos)

		lock(spawna, true)
		createdecal(spawna, Enum.NormalId.Top)
		setdecal(spawna, opts.SpawnDecal, Enum.NormalId.Top)
		transparency(spawna, 1)

		local pos1 = CFrame.new(74.143, 24, -25.232)

		transparency(rules, 0)
		setcollision(rules, false)
		createdecal(rules, Enum.NormalId.Left)

		color(rules, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))

		local pos2 = CFrame.new(1.143, 24, -25.232)

		transparency(bad, 1)
		setcollision(bad, false)
		createdecal(bad, Enum.NormalId.Right)
		setdecal(bad, opts.BadDecal, Enum.NormalId.Right)
		resize(bad, Vector3.new(4, 23, 37), pos2)
	end

	-- Скайбокс
	local function sky()
		local position = CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
		local skyPart = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", position, workspace)
		makemesh(skyPart)
		syncmeshid(skyPart, "139706960202832")

		syncmeshsize(skyPart, Vector3.new(20000, 20000, 20000))
		lock(skyPart, true)
		name(skyPart, "Sky")
		setcollision(skyPart, false)
	end

	sky()

	if remote then
		pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(";res all") end)
		task.wait(0.3)
		pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(";r6 all") end)
		pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(";time 14") end)

		pcall(function()
			remote:InvokeServer(";music " .. opts.MusicID .. " ;volume inf ; ;char all " .. opts.TitleName .. " " .. opts.TitleName .. " HAX THIS SERVER L0LZ")

local function addGridButton(section, text, callback)
	local idx = #section.buttons
	local col = idx % COLS
	local row = math.floor(idx / COLS)

	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, BTN_W, 0, BTN_H)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, col * (BTN_W + BTN_GAP_X), 0, row * (BTN_H + BTN_GAP_Y))
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextColor3 = PURPLE
	btn.TextSize = 12
	btn.ZIndex = 4
	btn.TextWrapped = true
	btn.Parent = section.container
	addStroke(btn, 1.2)
	if callback then btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback) end

	table.insert(section.buttons, btn)
	table.insert(allButtons, btn)

	local totalRows = math.ceil(#section.buttons / COLS)
	section.container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -PAD*2, 0, totalRows * (BTN_H + BTN_GAP_Y) - BTN_GAP_Y)

	return btn
end

local function finalizeLayout()
	local y = PAD + 30
	for _, sec in ipairs(sections) do
		sec.header.Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD, 0, y)
		sec.container.Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD, 0, y + HEADER_H + 2)
		y = y + HEADER_H + 2 + sec.container.Size.Y.Offset + SECTION_GAP
	end
	local totalH = y - SECTION_GAP + PAD
	MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, GUI_WIDTH, 0, totalH)
	return totalH
end

local function startFlying()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid then return end

	humanoid.PlatformStand = true

	bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bodyVelocity.Parent = root

	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 100000
	bodyGyro.CFrame = root.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root

	flying = true
end

local function stopFlying()
	flying = false
	if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
	if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end

	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		end
	end
end

		if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
			bodyVelocity.Velocity = camera.CFrame.LookVector * (moveDir.Magnitude * speed)

		end
	end
end)

speedLabel.Text = "Speed: 50"
speedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
speedLabel.TextSize = 14
speedLabel.Parent = frame

local sliderFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
sliderFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 170, 0, 10)
sliderFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 140)
sliderFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
sliderFrame.Parent = frame
local sliderCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
sliderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
sliderCorner.Parent = sliderFrame

local sliderFill = Instance.new("Frame")
sliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
sliderFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 255)
sliderFill.Parent = sliderFrame
local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
fillCorner.Parent = sliderFill

-- Dragging Logic (Restricted to Drag Bar)
local dragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil

dragBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = frame.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		local newPos = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		frame.Position = newPos
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		dragging = false
	end
end)

-- Minimize/Maximize Logic
local isMinimized = false
local originalSize = frame.Size
minimizeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isMinimized = not isMinimized
	minimizeButton.Text = isMinimized and "+" or "-"
	local targetSize = isMinimized and UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 30) or originalSize
	TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Size = targetSize}):Play()
	dragBar.Visible = not isMinimized
	flyButton.Visible = not isMinimized
	noClipButton.Visible = not isMinimized
	speedLabel.Visible = not isMinimized
	sliderFrame.Visible = not isMinimized
end)

-- Variables
local isFlying = false
local isNoClip = false
local flySpeed = 50
local bodyVelocity = nil
local bodyGyro = nil
local moveDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

-- Fly Function
local function startFlying()
	if not isFlying then
		isFlying = true
		flyButton.Text = "Fly: ON"
		flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 100, 60)
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0 -- Prevent walking movement interference
		bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart

		bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4000, 4000, 4000) -- Reduced torque for stability
		bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
		bodyGyro.Parent = rootPart
	end
end

local function stopFlying()
	if isFlying then
		isFlying = false
		flyButton.Text = "Fly: OFF"
		flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16 -- Restore default walk speed
		if bodyVelocity then
			bodyVelocity:Destroy()
			bodyVelocity = nil
		end
		if bodyGyro then
			bodyGyro:Destroy()
			bodyGyro = nil
		end
	end
end

-- No-Clip Function
local function setNoClip(state)
	isNoClip = state
	noClipButton.Text = "No-Clip: " .. (state and "ON" or "OFF")
	noClipButton.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(60, 100, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
	for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = not state
		end
	end
end

-- Fly Movement
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if isFlying and bodyVelocity and bodyGyro then
		bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
		local velocity = camera.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(moveDirection * flySpeed)
		bodyVelocity.Velocity = velocity
	end
end)

-- Input Handling
local inputStates = {}
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if isFlying then
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then
			inputStates.W = true
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then
			inputStates.S = true
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then
			inputStates.A = true
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then
			inputStates.D = true
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
			inputStates.Space = true
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
			inputStates.LeftShift = true
		end
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if isFlying then
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then
			inputStates.W = false
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then
			inputStates.S = false
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then
			inputStates.A = false
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then
			inputStates.D = false
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
			inputStates.Space = false
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
			inputStates.LeftShift = false
		end
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if isFlying then
		moveDirection = Vector3.new(
			(inputStates.A and -1 or 0) + (inputStates.D and 1 or 0),
			(inputStates.Space and 1 or 0) + (inputStates.LeftShift and -1 or 0),
			(inputStates.W and -1 or 0) + (inputStates.S and 1 or 0)
		)
	end
end)

-- Button Connections
flyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if isFlying then
		stopFlying()
	else
		startFlying()
	end
end)

noClipButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setNoClip(not isNoClip)
end)

-- Speed Slider Logic
local sliderDragging = false
sliderFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		sliderDragging = true
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		sliderDragging = false
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if sliderDragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local sliderPos = sliderFrame.AbsolutePosition
		local sliderWidth = sliderFrame.AbsoluteSize.X
		local relativePos = math.clamp((mousePos.X - sliderPos.X) / sliderWidth, 0, 1)
		flySpeed = 20 + relativePos * 130 -- Speed range: 20 to 150
		speedLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. math.floor(flySpeed)
		sliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(relativePos, 0, 1, 0)
	end
end)

-- Cleanup on character reset
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
	character = newCharacter
	humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	stopFlying()
	setNoClip(false)
end)
